title: Replication: less gyro filtering is monotonically worse
question: Repeat of run 9 — does the trend hold, and what does the raw-gyro segment do?
headline: Trend replicated and completed. 30 ms: 3.20 deg RMS. 15 ms: 7.14. Raw: 9.39 RMS with a 43.6 deg peak and 236 deg of drift. The gyro filter's phase lag is not what feeds the ring.
